details.biography:
Bruno Garotti was born in São Paulo, Brazil. He studied cinema at USP and debuted as a director in the ninth area as assistant director of the short film Oi, Meu Amor (2006), by Raphael Vieira. He debuted as a director in Anfitriiões (2006), a film shown at the São Paulo International Short Film Festival.

His career in features began with 'Eu Fico Loko' (2017), biopic of youtuber Christian Figueiredo. He rose to fame from the also youth comedies 'Anything for a Pop Star' (2018) and 'Cinderella Pop' (2019).
details.name: Bruno Garotti
